serverListHint: This list comes from BETTER_AUTH_ADMIN_USER_IDS on the current server. Listed accounts have super administrator access.
serverListChange: To add or remove a super administrator, update the server configuration and restart the service. Removing an account from this list preserves any ordinary administrator role it already has.
missingAccountHint: This ID is configured, but no matching account exists in the database.
banned: This account is suspended and cannot access administration.
backendRolesHint: Search for an account and open its details to grant or revoke administrator and reviewer roles. Super administrators are managed through the server configuration.
